meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动移除项目中未使用的代码，保证安全并生成原子提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目积累了大量死代码需要安全清理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically remove unused code with safety and atomic commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated dead code that needs safe removal

howto.what: Claude 会扫描项目里没有被别处引用的代码(多余导入、变量、函数、类型或文件),逐个确认后,把删除任务分批交给多个后台代理同时执行,每批单独提交一次;最后自动检查并输出已删/跳过清单,同时保护入口文件、测试和配置等不被误删。
howto.when: 当你说出“remove dead code”“dead code”“cleanup”等触发词,或要求清理项目里没用的代码时,该技能会接管。

say.text: 把项目里没人用的代码清理掉
say.note: 触发全项目扫描并删除死代码。
触发词,开始整个项目的死代码清理。

say.text: 只清理 src/utils 目录里的未使用代码
say.note: 只处理该目录,不动其他文件。

howto.what_en: Finds unused code (imports, variables, functions, types, files), verifies it is unreferenced, then parallel agents remove each batch and commit. Runs checks and reports removed/skipped; entry points, tests, configs protected.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say “remove dead code”, “dead code”, “cleanup”, or ask to clean up unused code in the project.

say_en.text: Clean up unused code in this project.
say_en.note: Scans the whole project and removes dead code.

say_en.text: Only clean dead code in src/utils.
say_en.note: Narrows the scan to that directory.
